brief:
The Follow-Up Committee, an organization representing Palestinian citizens of Israel, has called for a commemoration of the Al-Aqsa uprising in the town of Arraba on October 3, Shehab Wire reported. The event is designed to revive memory of the popular uprising that erupted in the early 2000s and became a defining moment in Palestinian resistance.

The committee's appeal marks a recurring effort by Palestinian groups within Israel to maintain public commemoration of pivotal dates in their national history. October 3 carries symbolic significance for Palestinians across the region, representing a period of sustained popular mobilization against Israeli occupation. The planned gathering in Arraba, a Palestinian town in the Galilee region, underscores ongoing efforts by Palestinian communities to preserve collective memory of resistance movements.
